parameters.content:
## Kettle 0: Load Demo Store (manual, destructive)
Clears the demo tables and loads a store dated relative to today: 14 products (three running low), about four weeks of orders with tracking (one stuck in transit, one on its way, one waiting to ship, one delivered), six abandoned checkouts that test each recovery rule, and two weeks of reviews with a jump in shipping complaints. A seeded generator makes the same store every time.
